cohort: 120 neonates (>37 weeks gestational age), including those with and without perinatal asphyxia, admitted to a Department of Paediatrics and Neonatology at a tertiary care center.
finding: Severe ECG changes (Grades 3 and 4) are specific markers of severe myocardial injury in critically ill neonates, while CK-MB elevation and reduced systolic function are reliable markers of ischemia detectable even in mildly compromised neonates.
birth_weight: Measured and compared between groups, no significant difference found.
